title: Software Engineer - ASICS Interconnect Tools
description:
Qualcomm Interconnect Technology (QITC) is looking for a Software Engineer to join their team at the boundary of software and hardware engineering. The role involves developing CAD tools for interconnect design and SoC integration.

Key Responsibilities:
- Gathering feedback and designing new features for interconnect CAD tools
- IP integration and configuration (cache coherent networks, etc.)
- Netlist analysis and transformation using graph and path-finding algorithms
- GUI development for topology and floorplan edition
- Generating collaterals for physical design flow (Verilog, SystemC models, verification environments)
- Participating in releases planning and quality monitoring

Technical Environment: Linux, Git, Qt, Python OOP, C++

Qualifications:
- Master's degree in Science/Engineering (or Bachelor's + 2+ years relevant experience)
- Object-oriented programming expertise
- Strong Python skills
- Software design best practices
- Interest in hardware technologies (Verilog, VHDL, SystemC)

Benefits: Collaborative environment, competitive salary, stock options, bonuses, insurance, education assistance
